hero.pitch: For process, automation and data teams with plenty of operational problems and nobody who speaks both engineering and code. I go from diagnosis to a working tool.
hero.headline: An engineer who turns plant data into decisions — and ships the software that runs them.
proof: 0.69% false alarm rate in anomaly detection

about.p1: I am a Chemical Engineering student at UFMG and an intern at BRASS Brasil, where I work with leak detection systems for slurry pipelines. My journey led me to discover the power of programming as a tool to solve engineering problems more efficiently.
about.p2: Today, I combine technical engineering knowledge with software development skills, creating solutions ranging from AI automation to applications that facilitate complex calculations in industrial processes.

problem.title: The bottleneck is not missing data. It is missing someone who speaks both languages.

items.title: Who understands the plant
items.text: Knows head loss and transients, but hits spreadsheets that do not scale.

items.title: Who understands code
items.text: Writes great software, but cannot tell whether the model output makes physical sense.

items.title: The result
items.text: Data projects that take months, trigger false alarms and lose the operators' trust.

method.title: Process → Data → Software
method.desc: Three steps, in this order. Skipping the first is why most industrial AI projects fail.

steps.title: Understand the process
steps.text: Mass balance, hydraulics, rheology. Before modeling, I understand the physics behind the signal.

steps.title: Model with data
steps.text: Python, ML and validation against real physical behavior, so the model is trustworthy, not just accurate.

steps.title: Ship the tool
steps.text: An API, web app or dashboard operators use every day, with documentation and a technical report.

fit.title: Who I am for — and who I am not
for_items: Your team has process data but few tools built on top of it
You need someone who can talk to operations and to IT
You value people who ship working prototypes, not just slides
fit.not_title: It probably is not for you if
not_items: The role has no technical or process problem involved
You are looking for a senior specialist with 10 years on the plant floor

items.q: You are still in university. Will you deliver?
items.a: I am a Chemical Engineering student at UFMG, with internships in three industrial operations. The projects above are public so you can check what I deliver.
Python, FastAPI, React, Next.js, Java, PostgreSQL, LangChain and Power BI. I pick the tool for the problem.
An email with three lines about the problem. In 20 minutes I tell you whether I can help, and if I cannot, I say so.

cta.title: Got a process that costs too many hours?
cta.text: Tell me in three lines. No commitment, straight answer.
